# Stop losing subscribers to failed payments you could have recovered

> Recover failed Stripe subscription payments with decline-code-aware retries and emails you control. Preview the recovery schedule for any decline code, then run the open-source server in your own account. Free, MIT, no per-recovery fee.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [Dunning Engine vs paid Stripe recovery services](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/dunning-engine/vs-paid-recovery-services.html)
